annotation.authors_or_issuer: Prime Minister's Office of Canada (Premier ministre du Canada)
key_provisions_or_claims: Strategy built on three pillars: build trust, create opportunities, strengthen sovereignty.
Targets C$200B growth, 250,000 AI jobs and AI adoption rising from 12% to 60% by 2034.
Plans to modernize legislation on privacy, deepfakes, online safety and chatbots, and expand the Canadian AI Safety Institute.
National AI training initiative and up to 90,000 youth placements.
Sovereign compute: world-class AI supercomputer and cloud infrastructure.
annotation.summary_en: Prime Minister's Office press release launching 'AI for All', Canada's national AI strategy. It sets out three pillars (trust, opportunity, sovereignty), with targets for economic growth, jobs and adoption, plans to modernize privacy and online-safety laws, AI training programmes and sovereign compute. Robotics appears only in passing.
annotation.title_clean: Le premier ministre Carney lance L'IA pour tous, la nouvelle stratégie nationale du Canada en matière d'intelligence artificielle
annotation.title_en: Prime Minister Carney launches AI for All, Canada's new national artificial intelligence strategy
